name: X-WebAgentBench
description: X-WebAgentBench is a multilingual interactive web benchmark designed to evaluate the planning and interaction capabilities of language agents across multiple languages in web environments. It aims to advance global agent intelligence by addressing the lack of multilingual agentic benchmarks and assessing cross-lingual alignment methods.
reputation: A very recent benchmark that is beginning to attract attention for multilingual web-agent evaluation, but it is not yet widely established as a standard community benchmark.
notes: Evaluates multilingual agent performance in interactive web environments; shows current models struggle even with cross-lingual techniques.
